ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms resource limits, a readiness probe and the latest-tag flag are declared; it does not show the workload schedules or becomes ready.
offer: Declare Kubernetes resource bounds and readiness independently of process existence. Pin deployed images rather than selecting mutable latest tags.

minimal.reason: Declare CPU and memory limits for the workload. Unbounded pods can starve the node, so set resource limits.

mid.reason: Declare a readiness probe. Process existence is not readiness, so define the endpoint or command that proves the service can take traffic.

maximal.reason: Set a latest image tag to false. A mutable tag changes what is deployed without a change record, so pin an exact version or digest.

rule.reason: Declare CPU and memory limits for the workload. Unbounded pods can starve the node, so set resource limits.
